input.body: Mr Finch, this is Donna from the lettings agency about your heating at 6 Primrose Court (ref R/13). You are not bothering anyone. We're treating this as an emergency and a member of our team will phone you shortly to arrange an engineer. Feeling dizzy matters: if it gets worse, or you have chest pain or breathlessness, please call 999. Otherwise you can call NHS 111 for advice. If you smell gas or feel unwell near the boiler, leave the room, open a window and call the gas emergency line on 0800 111 999. To keep warm: stay in one room, wear layers, use blankets and have hot drinks and hot meals. If you have a safe plug-in heater, use it, keeping it well clear of curtains and bedding. If a neighbour or friend can check on you, please ask them to.
